title: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Design Exploration on High Performance Computing Systems
abstract: arXiv:2603.11515v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Today's scientific challenges, from climate modeling to Inertial Confinement Fusion design to novel material design, require exploring huge design spaces. In order to enable high-impact scientific discovery, we need to scale up our ability to test hypotheses, generate results, and learn from them rapidly. We present MADA (Multi-Agent Design Assistant), a Large Language Model (LLM) powered multi-agent framework that coordinates specialized agents for complex design workflows. A Job Management Agent (JMA) launches and manages ensemble simulations on HPC systems, a Geometry Agent (GA) generates meshes, and an Inverse Design Agent (IDA) proposes new designs informed by simulation outcomes. While general purpose, we focus development and validation on Richtmyer--Meshkov Instability (RMI) suppression, a critical challenge in Inertial Confinement Fusion. translated_title: 高性能计算系统上自动化设计探索的多智能体协作
translated_abstract: 当今的科学挑战，从气候建模到惯性约束聚变设计再到新材料设计，都需要探索庞大的设计空间。为了实现高影响力的科学发现，我们需要提升快速检验假设、生成结果并从中学习的能力。我们提出了MADA（多智能体设计助手），这是一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体框架，能够协调专门的智能体来执行复杂的设计工作流程。其中，作业管理智能体（JMA）在高性能计算（HPC）系统上启动和管理集成模拟，几何智能体（GA）负责生成网格，逆向设计智能体（IDA）则根据模拟结果提出新的设计方案。尽管该框架具有通用性，但我们将开发与验证的重点放在Richtmyer-Meshkov不稳定性（RMI）抑制上，这是惯性约束聚变中的一个关键挑战。我们在两个互补的场景中进行评估：在高性能计算系统上运行流体动力学模拟……
tldr: 提出了MADA——一个由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，通过协调作业管理、几何生成和逆向设计等专门智能体，在高性能计算系统上实现复杂设计工作流程的自动化探索，并以惯性约束聚变中的Richtmyer-Meshkov不稳定性抑制作为验证案例。
en_tdlr: MADA is an LLM-powered multi-agent framework that coordinates specialized agents for job management, geometry generation, and inverse design to automate complex design exploration workflows on HPC systems, validated on Richtmyer-Meshkov Instability suppression in Inertial Confinement Fusion.
